description: CG9 is the named departure from PL15: queue authoring is socket-writable, because a queue item is ordinary project content at the same trust tier as loop.start's own params — and CG3 says the item IS a loop.start payload held in a queue. `attended` is the per-item declaration or absent for the project default (D5/D6), never inferred from who is watching; the row lands `pending` because D8 demands a size before anything is eligible, and the size is a fact of its own landing. `with` rides as authored (CG7 columns carry the component's identity).

params.goal: Add rate limiting to /api/search behind a per-key counter

item.goal: Add rate limiting to /api/search behind a per-key counter
